nom: COSRX The Alpha-Arbutin 2 Discoloration Care Serum

avis.titre: Cos FOR THE MOST BEST RESULTS
avis.texte: I literally love the efficiency of the whole entire line by CosRx. I don't even know where to start. It truly does exactly what is says it does. Im a loyal customer from here on out

I wanted to love this, I really did! I have done research on tranexamic acid and was stoked to find this serum at Ulta for 25 dollars. I have post acne scars and I saw this was highly rated and the price wasn't bad. I used it twice a day as directed and I started noticing new breakouts. I hoped it wasn't his product so I kept using it and I then started to get very tiny red bumps on the areas I applied the serum. I stopped using it. The breakouts went away and I decided I'd give it another try. The same thing happened again. I went into Ulta to return the product. I was told that even with a receipt if it's past 60 days they can't give you a refund or store credit. So be aware of that change in policy and do a patch test with this product first! I feel like there may be some sort of oil in this.

I used one bottle of this with no issues. I thought it helped some with evening out skin tone. But my second bottle is causing breakouts. More like skin irritation than acne. There is no ingredient in this that shoukd be a problem for me, so I wonder if something has oxidized and I received a bad batch.
This product is great for my sensitive skin. Its such an affordable price and it does what i need it to. Help lift dark spots from acne overnight.

I have very reactive sensitive rosacea-prone skin and this serum has helped immensely for my acne hyperpigmentation without irritating my skin. I have very reactive skin that I cant even use vitamin C derivatives. This serum has no vitamin C or exfoliating acids, so its perfect for sensitive skin. It's definitely slow acting and you have to be very consistent with it but i can see my dark spots fading faster than if I didnt use anything.

If you do add more than one layer, it gets pretty sticky/tacky, so layering on more moisturizer and SPF can get tricky--particularly if you plan on putting on makeup. I also think that there are better products out there for discoloration.

I don't use this on my face. I actually use it on my abdomen to fade discoloration of surgical scars. It has a nice light texture and doesn't feel sticky. I use it every day in the morning and at night I apply retinol. The combination of the two products has really done a nice job at lightening the discoloration of my scars. I also love that there are multiple active ingredients for fading discoloration so it's a great all in one serum!
I'm really enjoying this serum. When I use this consistently, my skin is brighter and smoother.

I have been using this since May and I will say its nice to have a product that addresses all sides of hyperpigmentation especially for black people. Very well formulated and a huge bottle. I use it 4x a week once a day. I have reactive super sensitive acne prone skin and eczema so I definitely purged. I started off slow 1x a week for 2 weeks the went up from there. You have to be serious about using sunscreen and a hat. Any serum will take a while to work nothing is magic in a bottle but if youre patient its worth it for older marks. New marks barely leave a mark and goes away fast. I combined mine with microneedling and my skin looks wayyyy different.
I finished the whole bottle but didn't notice any change for my darkspot. Good thing is I didn't breakout.
I am enjoying this serum. It applies well, and my skin appears smother.

avis.titre: AMAZING A MUST FOR DARK SPOTS/DISCOLORATION
avis.texte: about two weeks ago i was looking for a good serum to help with my dark spots and overall discoloration. there are so many serums out there but this one is truely amazing. my skin looks so even and lively. i use day and night after i wash my face and then moisturizer( both are la roche posay) in the morning the elta md tinted sunscreen. thank me later!
Skin is much brighter with no issue with my rosacea and sensitive skin

avis.titre: Works good but if you have sensitive skin use with caution.
avis.texte: I really think this has faded my dark spots, but with me having sensitive skin I can't use it on my arms, chest and legs too without breaking out in hives. Just pick a few spots at a time if you have sensitive skin.

avis.titre: I would  buy this product  again
avis.texte: My first time using this. Love the texture. Can't really see a difference in the discoloration yet around my chin and jaw area. But, I'll give it another try when I finish this bottle.

I got a sample of this product from Ulta upon purchasing another product. I used the sample every day/night for 2 weeks and it was working! However, when I went back and got the full bottle, it was no longer working for my skin. The hyperpigmentation came back x 2!!!

avis.titre: Best serum to target dark spots
avis.texte: My skin is pretty sensitive — every time I touch my pimples, or even if I just leave them alone, they leave dark spots. I currently have a lot of dark spots on my forehead, but this serum has been helping make them look less noticeable in such a short time. If you have dark spots from acne, I would definitely recommend this serum

avis.titre: Best serum to target dark spots
avis.texte: My skin is pretty sensitive — every time I touch my pimples, or even if I just leave them alone, they leave dark spots. I currently have a lot of dark spots on my forehead, but this serum has been helping make them look less noticeable in such a short time. If you have dark spots from acne, I would definitely recommend this serum

I have years of sun damange/hyperpigmention, bought this March 2025 during 50% off event. Been using it twice a day along with retinol and vitamin C. Can comfirm this did not work for me. I do like the texture and how easy it is to absorb.

avis.titre: First Thing I've Tried That Works
avis.texte: I have pale skin prone to redness and age spots. I've tried many different serums with no luck. This actually worked on me. Within one week I have my normal skin coloring and no irritation.
I've tried many different serums for dark Spots and redness on my face. This is the first one that worked-really worked! I have a new "must have" beauty product.

Tried it as COSRX is a great Korean brand and was hoping it would be different than all the others. Plus, all the positive reviews. But after twice daily usage for 2 months, there was nonchange to any of my dark spots. I did before & after pics & i think it actually got worse! Thankfully i purchased this when in 50% off!

avis.titre: BEST FOR SKIN IN GENERAL AND ACNE
avis.texte: first off I wanna thank the lady that gave me the free sample of this! now I'm addicted to it and it had done wonders to my face. I don't get a lot of pimples like little small ones at the most at random spot but most of the time my face is clear and smooth bc of this product. I use it day and night and see a HUGE difference in my skin and the smoothness of my face. I even left it on a pimple over night and by morning it was small as a mustard seed ( it was a kinda huge pimple and it was inflamed). I hate not a lot of ppl know about this product bc it TRULY works!!!
I purchased two when they were half off. I have not seen any results but hopeful.

I am enjoying this product. It feels heavenly going on, and my skin feels and looks very smooth when I use it. I feel it's too soon to determine how effective it is at clearing my hyperpigmentation. I'll try to provide an update if I notice any significant changes.
I love this stuff. Using it daily and when I put mineral sunscreen over this, it does not pill at all. It's not tacky either. Huge wins.

avis.titre: Must buy for anyone dealing with any type of breakout!
avis.texte: I did start to have a randole face breakeout and on day three it was really red. I walked into ulta and grabed this iteam, that has to have been the best decision of my life. This product worked in less than a few hours, it took away almost all fhe redness and slowly started to lower the breakout, buy this and you will have no regret
I got the serum free for my bday and decided to give this a try. I didn't have high expectations but it is amazing! I've been using it for two weeks and my skin already looks soooo much better!
I purchased three bottles while they were on sale. I have used it consistently for over a month with no change or results :(

I read reviews for this product online and decided to try it. It's early so I'm not seeing a lot of discoloration fading yet but I like the product. It doesn't cause any breakouts or irritation. Hopefully, with time I will see great results.

This serum is said to fade blemish scars, fade pigmentation concerns, balances skin tone, and improves brightness. It comes in a common glass dropper style serum bottle. So I've only been using for 1 week and so far these are my thoughts. It has no fragrance, is super lightweight, and absorbs really nice into the skin. I've added it to my skincare routine to help with some surgical scarring I had. I have only been applying 1 layer, but you can do 2-3 for intensive care. I have not got any breakouts from using this at all. In only 1 week I can see my surgical scarring definitely lighter in color. My skin also does look brighter as a whole! I can only imagine how great the results will be with continued use. But so far I'm loving this!

I found the COSRX Alpha-Arbutin 2 serum to be a reasonable serum to add to my skincare routine. I suffer from acne, and especially after summer, sun spots on my face. In the past, I have used vitamin C serums to help address discoloration, dark spots and age spots. After using the COSRX Alpha Arbutin serum, I would say that I prefer this over the vitamin c serums. The serum itself is thin and odorless. It is easy to apply and absorbs quickly, making little work of adding it to any skincare routine. Some of the benefits that I noticed was post acne mark lightening. I tend to get hormonal acne, and the spots can sometimes last for 4 weeks. I've noticed since using this serum that they are gone within a few days. I would definitely recommend this to anyone looking to shorten the life of discoloration, especially those due to acne.

I love this serum. I have very sensitive skin and this product doesn't cause me any breakouts or reactions, that is huge to me. There are age spots, sun spots and acne scars on my face, I do feel like this product is fading my dark spots. I also have combination skin and this serum is helping hydrate my skin where needed without clogging my pores. This serum is now a part of my daily routine and I plan to continue using it. I would definitely suggest trying this serum!

This serum is absolutely amazing! The texture is great, the bottle is glass and a nice quality, the packaging is eye catching and the scent is light and refreshing! After just a week of using this, I'm already seeing a difference in my dark spots and my acne is gone, even the little spots that usually linger! I'm super impressed and can't wait to see my results in a few more weeks!
Love it so much, my skin looks younger and without breakouts and blackheads
I've had awful dark spots post pregnancy. This serum has helped clear them up significantly! There is no smell and it's a nice texture - not sticky.

avis.titre: A good choice for sun spots!
avis.texte: The CosRX Alpha-Arbutin 2 Discoloration Care Serum was a good product. I do feel I see some fading of the spots and discoloration on my face. I definitely didn't notice any additional spots or anything occurring, even though I did spend quite some time in the sun. I like the bottle, it's sleek and the applicator is easy to use. You can control the amount of product pretty well with the dropper applicator. The only thing I don't like is if you get the product on your hands, it is kind of sticky. It only has a faint smell, which is nice.

This worked much better than i had expected it to. It's very lightweight and absorbs quickly into my skin. I'm prone to acne breakouts and get discoloration in my skin from those. After using this for a few weeks, I can notice a difference in my skin tone. It looks more even and balanced
this is a wonderful product - no odor or fragrance, sleek packaging and wonderful ingredients, no residue or grease or heavyness to the serum and it absorbs quickly and mattifies!
Serum penetrates the skin quickly, using additional moisturizer will be more effective, it takes a while to see the effect. Should buy

I was so excited to try a new product from COSRX! I think that this product came to me at the perfect time. I have been struggling really bad with acne and especially the hyperpigmentation that would be left behind after my battles with my acne (some cystic, some not). The Alpha-Arbutin 2 Discoloration Care serum is just what my skin needed to help it get back to a more even tone! It truly only took one week to see noticeable results. I'm not affiliated with COSRX, I'm just a fan of their products and especially this one. The ingredients are phenomenal and I did not notice any breakouts caused from this serum which is fantastic. I have a feeling this one might go viral! Great, great job with this one.

COSRX is easy to apply with a dropper, using only 2-3 drops onto hands spreading evenly over face. Within a week or two, I noticed the appearance of my dark spots going away. My skin feels calmer and there seems to be less blemishes.

I have used a similar product by another brand and it normally feels like someone is popping rubber bands on your face. I found that I experienced zero irritation or reactions in the skin. I tried it day and night. While it's not magic and didn't erase everything it has been a great improvement and I personally noticed less breakouts. Also I think the value is great. I used one dropper per use and that was plenary for my face and neck.

I have use the serum i like the consistency , I do see a little improvement in my dark spots (in the recent one) the old dark spots is no difference i get dark spots when i have a pimple so the skin gets very irritatedand its hard I think i have to use it for a longer time to see more improvement in my skin; but overall I do like it and it's very gentle on the skin

This alpha-Arbutin discoloration care serum by cosrx is amazing. This serum evens out my skin tone and fades dark spot. I have age/dark spots and this has really brightened my skin and made the dark spots less visible. This product really works and has made me feel so much more confident. I no longer her have to wear foundation to even my tone out!
I have been using this product for 3 weeks. I live in Florida and have discoloration from the sun. This product has already made a huge difference.

This is an amazing serum. My redness from previous pimples has lightened significantly and my skin is more even and calm overall. The texture is lightweight and sinks right into the skin, layers beautifully. I love this serum and highly recommended it.

avis.titre: Well packaged with a soft feel!
avis.texte: I genuinely liked this product! I haven't used many serums in my skin care routine before so I wasn't really sure how i would feel about this product, but it easily fit into my skincare/makeup routine. I do feel like I have dark circles and a bit of redness on my cheeks and I did notice a difference after using it for a week. I feel like my face looked brighter and I looked more awake.

I liked this a lot. I like to give honest opinions on skin care products because I've seen too many dishonest ones. This serum felt good on my skin. It didn't get rid of any discolorations though but my skin definitely felt soft. Not sure if that was the purpose as well but it's always a bonus to feel well moisturized.

To start I must say that it has been a slow process because I did not know how my skin would react to this new serum, so I have started slowly with my night routine and without forgetting my sunscreen the next day. I believe this is a serum with high chemicals but my skin has reacted positively, especially on the most marked spots on my cheeks. I will continue using it and I believe that consistency will give us the final results.

I really enjoyed using the Alpha-Arbutin 2 Discoloration Care Serum! It had a great texture and virtually no scent to it. It worked well at brightening my skin tone and felt nice on my face, not sticky at all like some other serums.

I kind of have mixed reviews about this product. I have cosrx products and have used them before. But honestly it takes more than 7 days of use to normally see improvements so unfortunately I have not seen improvements at this time. I do love the texture and like how it drys quickly on my face and doesn't leave a sticky residue.

This is a great product I really like how it make my skin feels and look, i have been using it for few weeks and i can notice a difference, my skin looks more even and smooth, i will continue to purchase
This serum is absolutely amazing for dark spots. I have dark circles under my eyes and it completely took them away! What a difference this serum made to my face!

This is such a lightweight serum which absorbs well. It doesn't have a scent which makes it perfect for sensitive skin. After trying it for almost 2 weeks, I can already see a difference in my acne marks. They've lightened up and my skin is glowing.

I've been using COSRX The Alpha-Arbutin 2% Discoloration Care Serum for a few weeks now, and I'm genuinely impressed with the results. The serum is lightweight, absorbs quickly, and layers well under the other skincare products and makeup I apply daily. It has significantly lightened my dark spots and evened out my skin tone without causing any sort of irritation, which is a big plus for my sometimes sensitive skin. The 2% Alpha-Arbutin concentration worked effectively by targeting my hyperpigmentation, and the gentle formulation, free from parabens and sulfates, provided me a peace of mind. The convenient dropper and bottle ensures easy application while maintaining hygiene. Over time, my complexion has started to look brighter and more radiant. Overall, this serum has become an essential part of my skincare routine, and I highly recommend it to anyone looking to address discoloration and achieve a more even, glowing complexion! My face is legit GLOWING!
I liked this product. I was skeptical at first but the results speak for themselves.
This serum works great on my acne scars, after 2 weeks of use I can see them fading off. But it makes my skin super dry
I wasn't sure if I would like this product, but I really did. I like the way it felt on my skin. I do have some discoloration on my cheeks. And I truly do believe it has helped diminish the redness.
I use this serum in the morning. It helps with brightening the skin as well as hydrating.

Alpha-Arbutin 2 Discoloration Care Serum has really good ingredients to help reduce hyperpigmentation. I have some hyperpigmentation from acne scars and this serum is helping the discoloration. I also have acne prone sensitive skin and this serum didn't irritate me at all. I felt this serum also hydrated my skin and made it look plump. The packaging is also really nice and the dropper bottle feels high end.

I think this serum is magic. I have always been very inconsistent with serums. I have a lot of discoloration on my skin and I find myself quickly losing patience waiting for serums to work... this was not the case. I could see this serum working in real time. Using it before I fell asleep, I felt like my skin was glowing by the time I woke up. I noticed results immediately. Very thankful for this product!

Since using this product 6 days ago. It looks like it is starting to work slowly but surely. Has little to no smell and it dries pretty fast. I used about 4 drops in total under each eye, over the top of my nose and close to the end of my eyebrows.

THIS PRODUCT WAS REALLY GREAT! IT PROVIDED RESULTS AFTER JUST A FEW USES AND GAVE ME SUCH A SMOOTH TEXTURE AND CUT DOWN ON DARK SPOTS. I HOPE WITH CONTINUED USE THAT IT WILL IMPROVE TO THE BEST RESULTS!

avis.titre: Dark Spots & Acne Scars Be Gone!
avis.texte: The Alpha-Arbutin 2 Discoloration Care Serum is a product that everyone needs to have in their skincare routine. As someone who has suffered with acne scars from cystic acne as a young adult, and then having quite a few dark spots from being in the sun, this product has built my confidence back up! Niacinamide is an ingredient that I have used in the past and with the addition of Tranexamic Acid and NAG, the serum left my skin with such a beautiful glow!

I'm not sure that a one week trial period was enough time to really see results with this serum. I don't particularly see a significant change like I had hoped. But it did seem like when I first started using it, that it was breaking up the dark spot into smaller pieces if that makes sense. I think it's a bit lighter after a week. I would like to try it a bit longer to really see results. But it does seem promising and I'm going to continue to use it and see how it does. Serum does leave a bit of a sticky residue but I don't mind it. This brand has a really good reputation, so I have high hopes for this serum. I will update once I've used it a bit longer. I think it's lightened a scar I had from a pimple that you can see near the top of my right eyebrow. It appears to be a lot less red, so it leads me to believe that this serum does work. Look for yourself at my before and after and decide. I think it's lightened. So glad I had the opportunity to test it! Thank you!
Cosrx discoloration serum is lightweight and effective. I used at night time everyday. I can see Result in 10 days. My dark spots faded away. Lightened my skin tone.

The serum has a lightweight consistency and I don't mind using it, but I haven't seen any major results in only a week. I plan to continue using it because it packs in a lot of beneficial ingredients in one product, which I love. This will keep my beauty routine simplified but potentially really effective. I look forward to seeing my skin improve and having dark spots fade.

I've been using this for just over 2 weeks now and can definitely see lightening in my hyperpigmentation from acne. I use the product once a day after washing my face, focusing on where I have the most hyperpigmentation. It doesn't take a lot of product and it never feels sticky or heavy. I have sensitive/ acne prone skin and have not had any negative reactions. I will continue to use this product.

Another awesome COSRX product! I don't think I've found anything from this brand I don't like. The Alpha-Arbutin 2 Discoloration Care Serum has such a nice finish on the skin. It makes my skin feel so smooth and hydrated, and using it over the course of a week I've already noticed my skin looks brighter and more even. The finish after applying is also really nice- it makes my skin look glowy and healthy.

I really enjoy that this product goes on smoothly and that it isn't super fragrant. It only takes a few drops to cover your face! It's hard to tell if it has improved any of my dark spots. Maybe with continued use, I will see results, but I haven't observed anything yet after a week.

I am very impressed with The Alpha-Arbutin 2 Discoloration Care Serum. I have tried many OTC and prescription skincare products to try to fade my hormonal hyperpigmentation and post-acne scarring. Some of those products were very expensive and didn't help me achieve the fading level I was anticipating. I have very fair skin and any type of dark spot is a big contrast between my skin tone. Dark spots take an extremely long time to fade so finding a product that will help speed that process up is important to me. I am shocked at how affordable Cosrx has made this serum. The ingredients are extremely high quality and potent. I like that the bottle is not clear so that it helps extend the potency of the serum. I like how the ingredients help support my already reactive and irritated skin, helps retain moisture in my skin and helps brighten my skin tone. It's a very lightweight and thin consistency. It's easily absorbed into the skin and it doesn't leave any lingering residue on the skin

avis.titre: Light serum good for sensitive skin.
avis.texte: Good and light serum for sensitive skin and acne prone skin. I have a lot of dark marks from acne scars, and it has helped lighten them without clogging pores and burning on sensitive skin.

I have been using this serum from 2 weeks now and i love how it absorbs into my skin and i am also able to see slight changes on my face where i have hyperpigmentation. Overall i will use this until completion of the bottle and expecting to have a good clear and even toned skin

I tried the alpha-arbutin 2 discoloration care serum for a little over a week. I have sun damage, age spots, acne scars and overall just discoloration in my skin. I used this product twice a day, morning and night. It absorbs beautifully and made my skin glow, and my dark spots fade! Especially the acne scar marks! It was gentle on my skin, and I really enjoy how my skin looks after using

I think that the serum worked pretty well to Fage my dart spots I would want to use it longer to really confirm that it's getting rid of my spots, but it worked very well overall and it's very lightweight

I really enjoyed the smooth texture of this product. Because of it I was able to use it during the daytime as well under my makeup products and it didn't give me a "patchy" look. Difficult to say whether it's fully effective as I've only used it for about 2 weeks

I use this serum at night and it works okay on my acne scars and isn't sticky. It is a lightweight serum and pairs well with my other skincare products. Overall I haven't seen significant fading using this product but maybe with longer term use I will.

It worked!! I have some dark spots on my face from acne. This serum makes them fade. I've only been using it for a week and I can see the difference. But there's one thing that I'm not very satisfied with: it makes my skin a bit dry while using it, even though I use moisturizer after using it. Should create a pair of serum and cream for the process of reducing and fading dark spots.

Love the packaging, very high quality. I so far am loving the product, I see more of a glow to my face. My dark spots are slowly lightening, I've got one major brown spot that I'm hoping this can improve over time. I will continue to use this product.

I have been on the hunt for a product that can help with my skin discoloration, and this stuff works pretty well! I love how easy it is to apply, no harsh odors and overall is just a convenient product. I didn't see any major differences with use, but I did visibly notice my discoloration fading a bit.

avis.titre: I am in love this serum
avis.texte: I am in love with this serum. It absorbs into my skin right away. I noticed this serum working after using a two weeks to get the results. I have spots and sun damages around my cheek areas and this serum helped to fade away. I will continue using it to get better results because my goal is to have glass skin.
I really enjoyed using this serum and will absolutely include it in my daily skincare routine.

This product works well! I enjoyed the application process and found it pretty easy to use! I noticed improvement in my dark spots without any irritation to my skin. Overall it's a good product. However, I think it'll take a bit to see final result.

After using the COSRX Alpha-Arbutin 2 Discoloration Care Serum on my hyperpigmentation for just over a week, I had impressive results. The serum was easy to apply, absorbed well, and provided brightening results comparable to my prescription treatments without the extreme cost and over-drying side effects!
Great quality! Puts on smooth and dries quickly. Saw a small noticable difference after just one week.

I love this serum! It goes on buttery smooth. It's not oily, or sticky. It leaves my face feeling nice and soft. When I sleep, I don't feel like I'm transferring it to my pillow. If I wanted to add something to my skincare routine, I can easily put something on after using this. The bottle comes with plenty in it. This should last my awhile. I little bit goes a long way! But the best part is my discoloration seems to be evening out.

I'm really impressed with this product so far!!! It has lightened my bright post acne spot incredibly in the last week. I honestly didn't think this could even be possible. I apply Tazarotene (prescription retinol) daily and it has not been able to do this. Amazing product! Can't wait to see what it can continue to do!!!
This serum is pretty good I did see a little bit of a difference I my acne scars I will keep using it to see if it continues to make a difference and reduce the appearance of my acne scars.
It does a decent enough job for discoloration, it doesn't completely get rid of discoloration but it definitely helps to fade them

I love the feel of this serum. It is silky smooth and glides on the skin nicely. After only a week of use I saw noticeable fading of the dark spots on my cheeks and jaw area. A little goes a long way, especially when avoiding the eye area. One quarter of the squeezer dispenser was enough to cover my while face and neck. I like to put it on after my toner and before the moisturizer, used twice a day as part of my skincare regime. Highly recommended for anyone who, like me,is facing dark spots or discoloration.

I want to share my admiration for the anti-pigment serum with arbutin and niomycin. This product truly exceeded my expectations! Already after a week of use, I noticed that the skin tone became more even, and pigment spots began to gradually lighten. Arbutin, known for its whitening properties, is very gentle and non-irritating, which is a huge plus for me. Niomycin, in turn, helps fight inflammation, making the skin healthier and more radiant. The serum is quickly absorbed without leaving any stickiness and is perfect for makeup. I recommend it to everyone who is looking for an effective means to fight age spots!
The serum made my skin feel moisturized and it has no fragrance. I think it may have slightly lightened it but I need to use it for longer to be sure. I had no negative side effects.

My experience with the product has been good so far. The serum bottle is easy to open and the applicator is great. The serum itself absorbs quickly into the skin and it doesn't have a smell. In the week that I have been testing it out, I did notice some purging but it didn't last long. I've noticed that in the week that I've been using it, my skin is brighter, spots are lighter, and the appearance of my scars are changing.
Great product! It definitely works, I had a couple acne scars and the one bad one has faded immensely since using this product. My skin has a nice glow to it as well.

My skin looks brighter and more even overall. I kind of have sensitive skin, and many other brightening products have caused irritation or dryness, but this one didn't. It absorbs quickly and doesn't leave any sticky or greasy feeling, which is a big plus
I was very pleased with the product. There is a noticeable difference with how brighter my skin is overall. It's not sticky, leaves no residue and has a neutral smell

ive been using it for about a week and i do see a little improvement in the color and its also more smoother. i'm sure it will continue to improve as i keep using. the only thing is i dont really like the smell

I had pigmentation problem but after trying this serum for two week there was visible changes in my skin. This serum was game changer for me. I will definitely purchase this again and again. I already recommended this to my friends and family.
The Serum is very smooth as I cover my face. My face was soft after I put it on and when I woke up the next morning. The Serum also helped some with spots I had in my face.

This COSRX Alpha-Arbuthnot 2 Discoloration Care Serum has been helping me lighten my dark spots I have around my chin and cheeks. I still need to keep using it to see the full affect but overall I think it's great. I do think there's a sent to it but I don't mind it. I feel like for me it leaves my face like with a rubbery film. It claims to have a powerful hyperpigmentation care and synergy boosters as well as skin calming after care, in which I think it's amazing as I do have sensitive skin and it helps it sooth my face. I have seen some improvements from using it for a week.

I've used this product for about 10 days, and I can see some lightening happening on a few of my dark spots. I think the real test will be after another few months of consistent use. But so far, so good.

I found that this product is exactly what my dermatologist and I are wanting, without the prescription cost. I've tried sulfur washes and many topicals, and I have never tried this until now. So far, I'm noticing good results with no irritation

After the first night of using this product my skin was incredibly soft and moisturized. I have a few dark spots from recent sun damage and I was hoping to reverse the effects on my face. While the serum did not erase my dark spots, after a week of using it directly on my problem areas, I see it is a bit lighter. My skin tans extremely easily, but hardly burns. I believe if I continue using for a month I could provide better results for my skin. Overall I like the serum. It's lightweight, and leaves my face feeling nourished and soft.
Really helped my hyperpigmentation and some dark areas around my mouth. I used it consistently and noticed a significant difference. Wasn't too harsh.
